Review rejection: this revision substitutes LLM-authored completeness booleans for authoritative guards, and still uses learned mappings to copy already-typed records. It also fails when consent is absent, because the conditional enters before checking whether consentSelector is null. Preserve business work, requirements, ten-product bound, write/output and cleanup; correct only this composition through an explicit structural revision.
1. Each foreach consuming a manifest MUST have requires = and(equal(output(manifestTask, observationManifest).captureTruncated,false), equal(output(manifestTask, observationManifest).manifestTruncated,false)). Use existing TaskValue predicates and references. Apply this to home, post-consent, results and every product manifest. Do not ask any transform to compute or decide completeness. A manifest's bounded cursor loop consumes ALL its pages before any action. A page-level requires rejects observation.captureTruncated; intermediate nextCursor is permitted while consuming its matching manifest.
2. Inside each cursor-reading loop, copy observation.records with an ordinary foreach whose body exports a value object of the needed actual fields. These pure copies compile to deterministic projections; do NOT use extract for them. Controls: text/group/role/selector. Search links: kind/tag/text/group/href. Product facts: kind/tag/text/group/role. Preserve all records, nesting and ordering. Export named page views; all consumers bind directly to that named foreach port. Remove the technical copy transforms home_observation_view, search_control_view and results_link_view after replacing their roles with these typed bindings. Keep the exact full producer data for later actions. No pagesComplete/captureComplete model outputs.
3. Consent selection may decide which observed control is authorized. The conditional itself MUST require consentSelector != null before entering the click branch, so absence is a successful no-op. Recapture and consume fresh pages afterward. Search needs an observed nonnull search control; absence/blockage must fail explicitly instead of pretending a search ran.
4. Global search selection interprets only its compact link views. Product name/description/price extraction stays extract over compact product views with nullable missing fields. Manifest flags never pass through inference. Final formatting may synthesize explicit absence messages outside extraction. Preserve the real file writer and root cleanup. No limits, permissions, or execution checks are relaxed.
